name: University of Zagreb
description: Croatia's oldest and largest university, and the top-ranked Croatian institution, offering a comprehensive range of disciplines across more than 30 constituent faculties and academies.

name: University of Split
description: A public university on the Adriatic coast with faculties spanning medicine, maritime studies, engineering, law, economics and the humanities, offering several programs taught in English.

name: University of Rijeka
description: A state university with faculties across the Kvarner region, offering English-taught programs in fields including medicine, biotechnology, mathematics and international business.

name: University of Zadar
description: The oldest university in Croatia, tracing its origins to 1396, with strengths in humanities, archaeology and social sciences.
